headline: TIDAL RUSH grabs back
lede: Flip and handstand riders now take the rail mid-air, every landing sprays like the trick that paid, and the wakeboard's own harness caught two real bugs in yesterday's verbs — CPU tricks actually flip now, and holding the handstand commit across a landing crawls instead of stalling the boat dead.

notes.text: Grab poses on the pitch verbs: brake alone = rail grab (flip), brake+gas = bow reach (handstand), released on the water — derived from the six wire bits already sent, zero pad-shape change (#3285).
Landings read by trick: corkscrew spray + deep thunk off a flip, a narrow column and expanding ring off a handstand.

Two bugs the new pins caught in #3276's own verbs: rival autopilots were secretly always handstanding (gas held through flip-arm), and gas+brake outran the engine and dead-stopped the hull — both fixed and pinned (tidalcheck 165/165, 19/19 mutants).
idle-kick's phantom pick (the pad-shape gap #3244's law forbids) is now marked BLOCKED in the README so the ladder stops kicking at an undeclinable gap.
